about: The picker, the popover, tooltips, touch, the focus ring, the keys that walk the desk, and drag and drop (33-overlays.mjs), with the older scenarios that exercise them.

scenarios.why: A Lab module added from a card outside Lab offers Lab in the popover; Not now closes it; Switch to Lab and add it; added with no anchor, a toast (labOffer, adding.ts).
A Modules card dropped on the desk lands at the place nearest the pointer; a cancelled drag adds nothing and leaves nothing behind (dnd.tsx).
A picker drawing dropped on the desk is added and the picker closes; a pedal brings the Pedalboard, a second joins in chain order, a side unit too.
A tile dragged by its header moves; a cancelled move puts it back.

The picker: its button and F9, the filter and its count, Enter, Escape, the category bar, the arrows, Home, End, Tab, Space, a Lab module's offer, one already on the desk, pointing, ×, the backdrop, F9 toggling.
The keyboard focus ring on Tab, a keyboard tip, Escape hides it, a pointer press turns the ring off, a pointer-focused knob shows none until an arrow.
Pressing and holding a control under a finger shows its tip, which goes by itself.
A resting pointer gets the page's tip and the browser's is held back; it goes when the pointer leaves and the title comes back.
A press on a grip offers the four moves in the popover (B-23); Move to the top; Undo puts it back (grip-menu.tsx).
The preview stands at the place nearest the pointer and the drop lands exactly where it stood; a drop that changed the order is one step; reading order is the order (Q-01, L-01).
The same at 1440.
The same at Lab, 1280.
The same at Quick.
A tip opens clear of the control's read-outs: the reels' LCD and cost line, a knob's value (L-06).
Under a finger a swipe that starts on a control scrolls and leaves it alone; resting first turns a knob; a sideways drag moves a ruler; each touch edit one step (S-29).
F6 enters the desk at its first module, each press the next in reading order, Shift+F6 back (S-33).
The sentence splitter keeps every digit; the VRAM meter's tip says 31.8 GB; every title on a full Lab desk splits with nothing lost (F-01, Q-01, E-04).
A control held under a finger shows its tip and is still pressed when the finger lifts: Generate, a tier (S-01).
A tip due inside the quiet 1.5 s after a press waits for it and opens once it is over, the pointer still resting on the Sampler's AUTO pill (L-06).
A drop scrolls nothing, and the tile stands where its preview stood (Q-15).
The preview is the tile's own face, the size it lands at; after the drag one tile carries its name (L-26).
At 1920x1080 the whole wall is on screen and nothing says below (F-05).
The same at 1600x900.
The same at 1536x864.
The same at 1440x900.
At 1280x720 every module is in view; the Pedalboard column scrolls by itself and its +N below scrolls that column only (F-05).
The count says what is shown (35 in all, 10 pedals, 5 side units); the pressed category is filled, All the size of its neighbours (F-09).
F-18: a toast raised while the picker is open joins its Tab cycle.
F-19: a tip the keyboard opened closes on the next pointer move.
F-29: F9 pressed while the picker is closing opens it again.
F-29: ArrowDown at the foot of the Modules column stays in it.
F-29: with a filter typed, the drawing Enter will take is ringed while focus stays in the filter.
Under a finger the picker speaks of taps, not keys and drags, and its close and categories are 40px (S-24, S-25).
S-36: the first vertical swipe that starts on a knob scrolls, and one toast says to rest a finger first.
07-overlays-keys/picker's checks without the generation queue; and Ctrl+Z under the picker undoes nothing and says so.
A tile dragged by its header moves, one step; a cancelled move puts it back; a cancelled pedal drag adds nothing and leaves nothing glowing.
The popover from a card: focus on its first choice, Escape gives focus back to the card, Tab past its last button closes it, a click outside closes it.
The ring on Tab, the keyboard tip with every digit, Escape, a pointer press, a pointer-focused knob and its first arrow (M-09, G-B-04).
The page's tip after a rest, the browser's held back, the title given back when the pointer leaves (C-31).
A tip due inside the quiet after a press waits for it (L-06), and opens clear of the knob's value.
An idle pedal's LED: its tip opens clear of everything the pedal reads out (L-06).
A held finger shows the tip, which goes by itself; a tier held 0.8 s is still chosen (S-01).
Swipes that start on a knob, a ruler, a number box or a pad change nothing; a rest then a drag turns the knob; a sideways drag moves the ruler; each one step (S-29).
F6 enters the desk, walks it in reading order, Shift+F6 back; not while the picker is open (S-33).
